name: 3DGS-MCMC
aliases: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo
definition: Reinterprets the Gaussian cloud as samples from an underlying probability distribution and uses Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to guide the life cycle (spawn/prune) of primitives, replacing noisy positional gradient magnitude heuristics.
summary: 3DGS-MCMC replaces 3D Gaussian Splatting's heuristic densification with a probabilistic Markov Chain Monte Carlo framework that precisely controls Gaussian count and reduces artifacts.
